sources.title: ibm-granite (IBM Granite) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Enterprise-grade AI models Efficient reasoning and thinking language models for multilingual generation, coding, and AI assistant workflows.

sources.title: Granite 4.2 - IBM
sources.snippet: Granite 4.2 is a family of dense reasoning language models available in three sizes: 3B, 8B, and 30B parameters. Granite 4.2 introduces native reasoning (thinking) capabilities, allowing models to perform step-by-step chain-of-thought reasoning before producing final answers.

sources.title: Granite - IBM
sources.snippet: IBM Granite is a family of open, trusted AI models for business, offering efficient language, vision, speech and guardrail models you can customize and deploy.

sources.title: granite4.2:3b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: IBM Granite Models are a family of enterprise-ready, open foundation models that support multilingual capabilities, coding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, thinking and structured JSON output. Released under Apache 2.0 license.
